project.title: 3D Office profiling
project.description: Little is known about the molecules that are present in the human habitat, or how human and microbial residents influence them. Using 3D cartographic approaches, we mapped the microbial composition and molecular migration among four human volunteers within a single office environment, to reveal the chemicals and microbes associated with specific niches within the human habitat. This cartographic analysis shows how both chemistry and microbes track human activity.
project.center_name: University of California San Diego Microbiome Initiative
